required_inputs: motor/actuator count and topology by trim
magnet material/grade and kg per qualified design
domestic production vs imported embedded components vs U.S. sales
inventory change, scrap/yield and replacement flows

criticality_method.rule: Use architecture/program-specific evidence, analyst interpretation labels, independent dimensions and visible unknowns; no universal official sector hierarchy.
contrasts: GM program evidence confirms NdFeB; plant receiving provenance remains missing.
Tesla Model Y mixes PM rear with induction front; material and grade not disclosed.
BMW planned iX5 EESM/ASM traction avoids PM magnets; auxiliary demand remains separate.
ABB SP4 HVAC product avoids magnets/rare earths, despite other ABB motor programs contracting NdFeB.
Robot/logistics products serve businesses/manufacturing and infrastructure; final retail beneficiaries do not imply household robot ownership.

demand_model.optional_formula: sum(actual units/year × confirmed eligible architecture share × magnets kg/eligible unit) / 1000
demand_model.note: For multi-motor/actuator products, kg/unit must aggregate only confirmed eligible parts. Use actual output or demand scenario basis explicitly; capacity does not mean demand. Material elements require a separate grade-composition model.

Vestas Szczecin→Baltic Power nacelle delivery does not establish magnet provenance.
Headquarters and U.S. sales/integration offices are not motor/robot manufacturing plants.
